        "contents": "| **Direct Agent** | AgentOrchestrator | 需要精细控制、工具调用、多轮对话 | ✅ 完全自主控制&lt;br/&gt;✅ 支持Function Calling&lt;br/&gt;❌ 需要自己管理复杂度 |\n| **Dify Agent** | DifyClient + Gateway | 预定义的复杂业务流程 | ✅ 快速配置&lt;br/&gt;✅ 可视化编排&lt;br/&gt;❌ 依赖外部平台 |\n| **工作流引擎** | LangGraphEngine | 多节点编排、条件分支 | ✅ 灵活的DAG执行&lt;br/&gt;❌ 不支持循环&lt;br/&gt;❌ 节点扩展性差 |\n\n---\n\n## 二、核心组件详解\n\n### 2.1 AgentOrchestrator（Agent编排器）\n\n**位置**: &#96;backend/src/services/agent/AgentOrchestrator.ts&#96;\n\n#### 核心职责\n- 执行Direct Agent类型的AI角色\n- 管理完整的Agent生命周期（从请求到响应）\n- 协调Prompt、Context、Tool的执行\n\n#### 关键特性\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// 核心执行方法\nasync executeAgent(\n  roleId: string,\n  query: string,\n  conversationId: string = '',\n  context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {}\n): Promise&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**执行流程**:\n1. 加载Agent配置（从数据库）\n2. 渲染System Prompt（变量替换）\n3. 获取上下文消息（根据策略）\n4. 构建完整消息列表\n5. 准备工具定义（Function Calling格式）\n6. 调用LLM（支持多轮工具调用循环，最多10轮）\n7. 保存消息历史\n8. 返回执行结果\n\n**超时控制**:\n- ✅ 总体超时: 6分钟\n- ✅ 单个工具调用超时: 60秒\n- ✅ 最大工具调用迭代: 10轮\n\n**问题点**:\n- ⚠️ 只支持OpenAI Provider（其他Provider标记为TODO）\n- ⚠️ 工具调用为串行执行，无并行优化\n- ⚠️ 缺少重试机制（只在LLM层有重试）\n\n---\n\n### 2.2 PromptManager（Prompt管理器）\n\n**位置**: &#96;backend/src/services/agent/PromptManager.ts&#96;\n\n#### 核心职责\n- Prompt模板渲染\n- 变量替换（支持&#96;{{variable}}&#96;和&#96;{variable}&#96;格式）\n- 嵌套属性解析（如&#96;user.profile.name&#96;）\n\n#### 变量类型\n- &#96;static&#96;: 静态值\n- &#96;dynamic&#96;: 从上下文动态获取\n- &#96;context&#96;: 直接使用上下文中的值\n\n---",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "| **Direct Agent** | AgentOrchestrator | 需要精细控制、工具调用、多轮对话 | ✅ 完全自主控制&lt;br/&gt;✅ 支持Function Calling&lt;br/&gt;❌ 需要自己管理复杂度 |",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行多个工具调用（支持并行执行）\n   */\n  private async executeTools(\n    toolCalls: any[],\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void,\n    executionId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;Array&lt;{ toolCallId: string; toolName: string; content: string }&gt;&gt; {\n    // 判断是否可以并行执行\n    const canParallel = this.canExecuteInParallel(toolCalls, toolConfigs);\n\n    if (canParallel) {\n      // 并行执行工具\n      const promises = toolCalls.map(toolCall =&gt; {\n        const config = toolConfigs.find(t =&gt; t.enabled &amp;&amp; t.name === toolCall.function.name);\n        \n        if (!config) {\n          return Promise.resolve({\n            toolCallId: toolCall.id,\n            toolName: toolCall.function.name,\n            content: JSON.stringify({ error: &#96;工具不存在或已禁用: ${toolCall.function.name}&#96; })\n          });\n        }\n\n        return this.executeSingleTool(toolCall, config, checkTimeout, executionId);\n      });\n\n      const results = await Promise.all(promises);\n      return results;\n    } else {\n      // 串行执行工具（保证顺序，适用于workflow、agent等有依赖的工具）\n      const results: Array&lt;{ toolCallId: string; toolName: string; content: string }&gt; = [];\n\n      for (const toolCall of toolCalls) {\n        // 在每个工具调用前检查超时\n        if (checkTimeout) {\n          checkTimeout();\n        }\n        \n        const config = toolConfigs.find(t =&gt; t.enabled &amp;&amp; t.name === toolCall.function.name);\n        \n        if (!config) {\n          results.push({\n            toolCallId: toolCall.id,\n            toolName: toolCall.function.name,\n            content: JSON.stringify({ error: &#96;工具不存在或已禁用: ${toolCall.function.name}&#96; })\n          });\n          continue;\n        }\n\n        // 使用executeSingleTool方法执行单个工具\n        const result = await this.executeSingleTool(toolCall, config, checkTimeout, executionId);\n        results.push(result);\n      }\n\n      return results;\n    }\n  }\n\n\n  /**\n   * 准备工具定义（转换为 OpenAI Function 格式）\n   */\n  private prepareTools(toolConfigs: ToolConfig[]): Tool[] {\n    return\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "### 3.4 工具调用链路（嵌套）\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nLLM响应包含工具调用\n  ↓\nAgentOrchestrator.executeTools()\n  ↓\n遍历工具调用列表\n  ↓\nToolExecutor.executeTool()\n  ↓\n根据工具类型执行\n  ├─ search: 执行搜索（基于DifyClient AI Search）\n  ├─ calculation: 执行计算（使用mathjs库）\n  ├─ time: 获取时间\n  ├─ api: HTTP请求\n  ├─ workflow: 调用工作流\n  │   └─ LangGraphEngine.execute() [使用LangGraphEngine替代]\n  └─ agent: 嵌套Agent调用（支持最多3层深度）\n      └─ AgentOrchestrator.executeAgent() [递归，带深度控制]\n  ↓\n返回工具执行结果（JSON格式）\n  ↓\n将结果加入消息历史\n  ↓\n继续LLM调用循环\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3.5 多轮对话上下文管理链路\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n用户发送消息\n  ↓\n检查conversationId\n  ├─ 存在: 加载历史消息\n  └─ 不存在: 生成新的conversationId\n  ↓\nContextManager.getContextMessages()\n  ↓\n根据策略类型处理\n  ├─ window: 保留最近N条\n  ├─ summary: 旧消息摘要 + 最近消息\n  └─ hybrid: Token限制 + 消息数量限制\n  ↓\n构建消息列表\n  ├─ system prompt（可选）\n  ├─ 历史消息（根据策略）\n  └─ 当前用户消息\n  ↓\n发送给LLM\n  ↓\n保存消息历史\n  ├─ 用户消息\n  └─ 助手回复\n  ↓\n返回结果（包含conversationId）\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 四、数据流转\n\n### 4.1 消息数据结构\n\n**ChatMessage**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n{\n  role: 'system' | 'user' | 'assistant' | 'tool',\n  content: string,\n  name?: string,  // 工具名称\n  tool_call_id?: string  // 工具调用ID\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**AgentExecutionResult**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n{\n  content: string,\n  conversationId: string,\n  usage: {\n    promptTokens: number,\n    completionTokens: number,\n    totalTokens: number\n  },\n  metadata?: {\n    model: string,\n    finishReason: string,\n    toolCalls: number\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4.2 上下文数据结构\n\n**sharedContext** (工作流):\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n{\n  workflowInput: any,  // 工作流输入",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\nasync executeAgent(\n    roleId: string,\n    query: string,\n    conversationId: string = '',\n    context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt; {\n\n    \n    try {\n      // 1. 获取 Agent 配置\n      checkTimeout();\n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'load_config', {\n        type: 'config',\n        input: { roleId },\n        output: null,\n        duration: 0,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n\n      const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\n      if (!role) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;AI角色不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      if (!role.agentConfig) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;Agent配置不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      const config = role.agentConfig;\n\n      // 2. 生成或使用 conversationId\n      const finalConversationId = conversationId || this.generateConversationId();\n\n      // 3. 检查 prompt 配置\n      if (!config.prompt) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;Agent prompt配置不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      if (!config.prompt.systemPrompt) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;Agent systemPrompt配置不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      // 4. 渲染 System Prompt\n      const promptStartTime = Date.now();\n      const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\n        config.prompt.systemPrompt,\n        config.prompt.variables || [],\n        context\n      );\n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'render_prompt', {\n        type: 'prompt',\n        input: { systemPrompt: config.prompt.systemPrompt, variables: config.prompt.variables, context },\n        output: { systemPrompt },\n        duration: Date.now() - promptStartTime,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n\n      // 4. 获取上下文消息\n      checkTimeout();\n      const contextStartTime = Date.now();\n      const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\n        finalConversationId,\n        config.contextStrategy,\n        query\n      );\n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'load_context', {\n        type: 'context',\n        input:\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\nasync execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n      const effectiveOutputMappings = featureConfig.outputMappings?.length\n        ? featureConfig.outputMappings\n        : targetMappingConfig?.outputMappings || [];\n\n      const baseContent = await this.resolveBaseContent(conversation, dto);\n      const conversationQuery = baseContent || &#96;触发子Agent：${dto.featureType}&#96;;\n\n      const conversationData = this.buildConversationData(\n        conversation,\n        conversationQuery,\n        targetSources,\n        dto\n      );\n\n      const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, effectiveInputMappings);\n\n      // 判断 targetWorkflowId 是 AI 角色 ID 还是工作流 ID\n      // AI 角色 ID 可能以 'role_' 或 'ai-role-' 开头，工作流 ID 以 'wf_' 开头\n      const isRoleId = targetWorkflowId.startsWith('role_') || targetWorkflowId.startsWith('ai-role-');\n      \n      let workflowResult;\n      if (isRoleId) {\n        // 直接调用 AI 角色\n        logger.info('检测到 AI 角色 ID，直接调用角色', { roleId: targetWorkflowId, featureType: dto.featureType });\n        workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeRole(targetWorkflowId, workflowInput);\n      } else {\n        // 通过工作流调用\n        logger.info('检测到工作流 ID，通过工作流调用', { workflowId: targetWorkflowId, featureType: dto.featureType });\n        workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(\n          targetWorkflowId,\n          { input: workflowInput }\n        );\n      }\n\n      const extractedOutput = extractWorkflowOutput(workflowResult, effectiveOutputMappings);\n\n      const aiContent = extractedOutput.content\n        || workflowResult.message\n        || &#96;子Agent ${dto.featureType} 已执行&#96;;\n\n      const messageOutputs = {\n        ...extractedOutput,\n,\n      };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "{\n  workflowInput: any,  // 工作流输入\n  nodeOutputs: {       // 节点输出\n    [nodeId]: any\n  },\n  [variableName]: any  // 自定义变量\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4.3 工具调用数据结构\n\n**ToolCall**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n{\n  id: string,\n  function: {\n    name: string,\n    arguments: string  // JSON字符串\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**ToolConfig**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n{\n  id: string,\n  name: string,\n  description: string,\n  type: 'search' | 'api' | 'calculation' | 'workflow' | 'agent' | 'time',\n  enabled: boolean,\n  parameters: ToolParameter[],\n  implementation?: {\n    endpoint?: string,\n    method?: string,\n    headers?: Record&lt;string, string&gt;,\n    workflowId?: string,\n    agentId?: string\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 五、关键设计模式\n\n### 5.1 策略模式\n- **上下文策略**: Window、Summary、Hybrid\n- **工具执行策略**: 根据工具类型选择执行方式\n\n### 5.2 责任链模式\n- **工具调用链**: LLM → Tool → Result → LLM（循环）\n- **工作流节点链**: 按拓扑顺序执行\n\n### 5.3 适配器模式\n- **Dify响应适配**: 统一不同Dify应用的响应格式\n- **工具格式适配**: 将ToolConfig转换为OpenAI Function格式\n\n### 5.4 工厂模式\n- **LLM Provider工厂**: 根据配置创建不同的Provider实例（支持OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Local）\n- **DifyGateway工厂**: 根据应用类型创建Gateway实例\n\n### 5.5 观察者模式\n- **执行追踪**: 记录每个执行步骤的详细信息\n- **性能监控**: 记录执行时间和Token使用量\n\n---\n\n## 六、性能与限制\n\n### 6.1 超时控制\n- **总体超时**: 6分钟（Agent执行）\n- **工具超时**: 60秒（单个工具调用）\n- **LLM调用**: 由Provider控制\n\n### 6.2 迭代限制\n- **工具调用循环**: 最多10轮\n- **防止无限循环**: 达到限制后返回最后一次响应\n\n### 6.3 Token管理\n- **上下文策略**: 通过Token估算控制上下文长度\n- **摘要生成**: 超过限制时自动生成摘要\n\n### 6.4 并发控制\n- **工作流节点**: 同一层节点可并行执行\n- **工具调用**: 智能并行执行\n  ",

        "contents": "- &#96;context&#96;: 直接使用上下文中的值\n\n---\n\n### 2.3 ContextManager（上下文管理器）\n\n**位置**: &#96;backend/src/services/agent/ContextManager.ts&#96;\n\n#### 支持的策略\n\n| 策略类型 | 特点 | 适用场景 |\n|---------|------|---------|\n| **Window** | 保留最近N条消息 | 短对话场景 |\n| **Summary** | 旧消息压缩为摘要 | 长对话场景 |\n| **Hybrid** | Token限制+消息数量限制 | 智能平衡场景 |\n\n**关键特性**:\n- ✅ Token估算和优化\n- ✅ 自动摘要生成（超过限制时）\n- ⚠️ 摘要生成依赖LLM，增加成本\n\n---\n\n### 2.4 ToolExecutor（工具执行器）\n\n**位置**: &#96;backend/src/services/agent/ToolExecutor.ts&#96;\n\n#### 支持的工具类型\n\n| 工具类型 | 功能描述 | 实现状态 |\n|---------|---------|---------|\n| &#96;search&#96; | 搜索工具 | ❌ 占位符（待实现） |\n| &#96;calculation&#96; | 数学计算 | ✅ 已实现 |\n| &#96;time&#96; | 时间获取 | ✅ 已实现 |\n| &#96;api&#96; | HTTP API调用 | ✅ 已实现（支持GET/POST/PUT/DELETE） |\n| &#96;workflow&#96; | 工作流调用 | ⚠️ 已实现但AgentWorkflowService已移除 |\n| &#96;agent&#96; | Agent嵌套调用 | ❌ 占位符（待实现） |\n\n**工具调用流程**:\n1. 解析工具调用参数（JSON格式）\n2. 验证参数（类型、必需性、枚举值）\n3. 根据工具类型执行相应逻辑\n4. 返回JSON格式的执行结果\n\n**问题点**:\n- ❌ &#96;workflow&#96;工具依赖的&#96;AgentWorkflowService&#96;已被移除为占位符\n- ❌ &#96;search&#96;和&#96;agent&#96;工具未实现\n- ⚠️ &#96;calculation&#96;工具使用&#96;eval&#96;存在安全风险\n\n---\n\n### 2.5 OpenAIProvider（LLM Provider）\n\n**位置**: &#96;backend/src/services/llm/OpenAIProvider.ts&#96;\n\n#### 核心特性\n- ✅ 支持OpenAI API调用\n- ✅ 支持工具调用（Function Calling）\n- ✅ 重试机制（最多3次，指数退避）\n- ✅ 超时控制（180秒）\n- ✅ 支持o1/o3/gpt-5.1等reasoning模型\n\n**问题点**:\n- ⚠️ 只支持OpenAI，其他Provider（如Anthropic、Google等）标记为TODO\n- ⚠️ 缺少Mock模式（开发测试时节省成本）\n\n---",

        "contents": "# AI Agent 框架优化任务清单\n\n&gt; 基于 &#96;AI_AGENT_FRAMEWORK_ANALYSIS.md&#96; 生成的可执行任务清单  \n&gt; 更新时间: 2025-01-08\n\n---\n\n## 🔴 P0: 紧急任务（必须立即修复）\n\n### ✅ T1: 修复 AgentWorkflowService 移除问题\n- **问题**: AgentWorkflowService已被移除为占位符，导致workflow工具完全失效\n- **影响**: 所有依赖工作流工具的Agent无法正常工作\n- **方案**: 使用LangGraphEngine替代\n- **工作量**: 2天\n- **步骤**:\n  1. [ ] 修改 &#96;ToolExecutor.ts&#96; 中的 &#96;executeWorkflow&#96; 方法，直接调用 &#96;LangGraphEngine&#96;\n  2. [ ] 更新所有依赖 &#96;AgentWorkflowService&#96; 的代码\n  3. [ ] 测试workflow工具调用\n  4. [ ] 更新相关文档\n\n### ✅ T2: 支持 Direct Agent 在工作流中使用\n- **问题**: LangGraphEngine禁止Direct Agent类型，限制了灵活性\n- **位置**: &#96;backend/src/services/workflow/langgraph/LangGraphEngine.ts:133&#96;\n- **工作量**: 1天\n- **步骤**:\n  1.         "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行 Agent（核心方法）\n   * @param roleId 角色ID\n   * @param query 用户查询\n   * @param conversationId 对话ID（可选，如果不存在会生成新的）\n   * @param context 上下文数据（用于变量替换）\n   * @returns 执行结果\n   */\n  async executeAgent(\n    roleId: string,\n    query: string,\n    conversationId: string = '',\n    context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt; {\n    // 生成执行ID（用于追踪）\n    const executionId = context.executionId || &#96;exec-${Date.now()}-${uuidv4()}&#96;;\n    this.currentExecutionId = executionId;\n    this.currentAgentId = roleId;\n\n    // Mock模式检查\n    if (process.env.AI_MOCK_MODE === 'true') {\n      const mockResult = await this.getMockResponse(roleId, query, context);\n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'mock_response', {\n        type: 'mock',\n        input: { query, context },\n        output: { content: mockResult.content },\n        duration: 0,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n      return mockResult;\n    }\n\n    const startTime = Date.now();\n    const MAX_EXECUTION_TIME = 360000; // 6分钟总体超时（留出缓冲给前端7分钟超时）\n    \n    // 检查超时的辅助函数\n    const checkTimeout = () =&gt; {\n      const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;\n      if (elapsed &gt; MAX_EXECUTION_TIME) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;Agent执行超时：已执行 ${Math.round(elapsed / 1000)} 秒，超过最大执行时间 ${MAX_EXECUTION_TIME / 1000} 秒&#96;);\n      }\n    };\n    \n    try {\n      // 1. 获取 Agent 配置\n      checkTimeout();\n  }\n}",

基于文档要求，评估当前系统功能实现：

## 功能实现评估报告

### ✅ 已实现的功能

1. **Agent 角色配置**
   - ✅ 在 `pageConfigs.ts` 中配置了 4 个专家角色（技术原教旨、场景炼金术、市场狙击手、内容大导演）
   - ✅ 每个角色关联了对应的工具 ID

2. **UI 布局**
   - ✅ 双栏布局：左侧对话区（`DialogueContent`），右侧工具箱（`StudioSidebar`）
   - ✅ 右侧支持 Dashboard 和 Workspace 两种视图模式
   - ✅ 按角色分组显示工具卡片

3. **工具可视化**
   - ✅ `StudioSidebar` 中有 `renderRoleSpecificContent`，展示不同角色的执行状态
   - ✅ 工具执行时显示加载动画和状态提示

4. **后端工具调用能力**
   - ✅ `AgentOrchestrator` 支持 Function Calling
   - ✅ `ToolExecutor` 支持 Agent 嵌套调用（`executeAgent`）
   - ✅ 支持 Direct Agent 类型的工具调用

### ❌ 缺失的关键功能

1. **主 Agent 主动调用工具**
   - ❌ 主 Agent 的 Prompt 中未定义工具调用能力（Consult_Tech、Consult_Scene 等）
   - ❌ 主 Agent 无法根据对话上下文自动判断并调用专家工具
   - ❌ 当前工具调用仅支持用户手动点击触发

2. **右侧面板自动展开**
   - ❌ 主 Agent 调用工具时，右侧面板未自动展开对应视图
   - ❌ 缺少工具调用事件的监听和响应机制

3. **工具执行结果实时展示**
   - ❌ 缺少 SSE（Server-Sent Events）流式输出
   - ❌ 工具执行结果未在右侧面板实时展示
   - ❌ 当前仅显示加载状态，无实际结果展示

4. **人机协作交互**
   - ❌ 用户无法在右侧面板直接修改专家输出
   - ❌ 缺少用户修改后同步回主 Agent 的机制

5. **工具调用流程可视化**
   - ❌ 对话流中未显示“正在调用 XXX 工具...”的状态卡片
   - ❌ 缺少工具调用过程的完整可视化链路

### 📊 实现度评估

| 功能模块 | 完成度 | 说明 |
|---------|--------|------|
| 角色配置 | 100% | 配置完整 |
| UI 布局 | 80% | 布局完成，缺少自动展开 |
| 工具可视化 | 60% | 有基础展示，缺少实时结果 |
| 主 Agent 工具调用 | 0% | 未实现主动调用逻辑 |
| 人机协作 | 0% | 未实现修改和同步机制 |
| 整体实现度 | **48%** | 基础框架完成，核心功能缺失 |

### 🔧 需要补充的关键实现

1. **主 Agent Prompt 增强**
   - 在主 Agent 的 System Prompt 中定义 4 个工具（Consult_Tech、Consult_Scene、Consult_Market、Consult_Content）
   - 明确工具调用时机和条件

2. **工具调用事件系统**
   - 建立前端与后端的工具调用事件通道
   - 主 Agent 调用工具时，前端自动展开右侧对应视图

3. **SSE 流式输出**
   - 实现工具执行结果的流式推送
   - 在右侧面板实时展示专家思考过程和结果

4. **结果编辑与同步**
   - 支持用户在右侧面板编辑专家输出
   - 编辑后同步回主 Agent，继续对话

### 总结

当前系统已具备基础框架和 UI，但核心的“主控 Agent + 专家工具”协作机制尚未实现。主要缺失：
- 主 Agent 主动调用工具的能力
- 工具调用过程的实时可视化
- 人机协作的闭环交互

建议优先实现主 Agent 的工具调用能力，这是整个系统的核心。

        "contents": "export class ToolExecutor {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行工具调用\n   * @param toolCall 工具调用信息\n   * @param toolConfig 工具配置\n   * @returns 执行结果（JSON 字符串）\n   */\n  async executeTool(toolCall: ToolCall, toolConfig: ToolConfig): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 解析参数\n      const args = JSON.parse(toolCall.function.arguments || '{}');\n\n      // 验证参数\n      this.validateParameters(args, toolConfig.parameters);\n\n      // 根据工具类型执行\n      let result: ToolExecutionResult;\n\n      switch (toolConfig.type) {\n        case 'search':\n          result = await this.executeSearch(args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'calculation':\n          result = this.executeCalculation(args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'time':\n          result = this.getTime(args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'api':\n          result = await this.executeAPI(toolConfig, args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'workflow':\n          result = await this.executeWorkflow(toolConfig, args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'agent':\n          result = await this.executeAgent(toolConfig, args);\n          break;\n\n        default:\n          result = {\n            success: false,\n            content: JSON.stringify({ error: &#96;不支持的工具类型: ${toolConfig.type}&#96; })\n          };\n      }\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return JSON.stringify({ error: result.error || '工具执行失败' });\n      }\n\n      return result.content;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(&#96;工具执行失败: ${toolConfig.name}&#96;, error);\n      return JSON.stringify({\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '工具执行失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 验证参数\n   */\n  private validateParameters(args: any, parameters: ToolConfig['parameters']): void {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\nasync executeAgent(\n    roleId: string,\n    query: string,\n    conversationId: string = '',\n    context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt; {\nconst contextMessages = await \n\n      );\n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'load_context', {\n        type: 'context',\n        input: { conversationId: finalConversationId, strategy: config.contextStrategy, query },\n        output: { messageCount: contextMessages.length },\n        duration: Date.now() - contextStartTime,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n\n      // 5. 检查 contextStrategy 配置\n      if (!config.contextStrategy) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;Agent contextStrategy配置不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      // 6. 构建完整消息列表\n      const messages: ChatMessage[] = [];\n      \n      // 根据策略决定是否包含 system prompt\n      if (config.contextStrategy.includeSystemPrompt || contextMessages.length === 0) {\n        messages.push({\n          role: 'system',\n          content: systemPrompt\n        });\n      }\n\n      messages.push(...contextMessages);\n      messages.push({\n        role: 'user',\n        content: query\n      });\n\n      // 6. 准备工具定义（Function Calling）\n      const tools = this.prepareTools(config.tools || []);\n\n      // 7. 获取 LLM Provider\n      const provider = this.getProvider(config.llm);\n\n      // 8. 调用 LLM（可能包含多轮工具调用）\n      checkTimeout();\n      const llmStartTime = Date.now();\n      let response = await this.executeWithTools(provider, messages, config.llm, tools, config.tools || [], checkTimeout, executionId);\n      const llmDuration = Date.now() - llmStartTime;\n      \n      // 记录性能指标\n      await this.recordPerformanceMetrics(executionId, 'llm_call', llmDuration, response.usage);\n      \n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'llm_call', {\n        type: 'llm',\n        input: { messageCount: messages.length, toolCount: tools.length },\n        output: { content: response.content, toolCalls: response.toolCalls?.length || 0 },\n        duration: llmDuration,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n\n      // 9. 保存消息历史\n      await this.saveMessages(finalConversationId, query, response, roleId);\n\n      // 10. 返回结果\n      const totalDuration = Date.now() - startTime;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行多个工具调用（支持并行执行）\n   */\n  private async executeTools(\n    toolCalls: any[],\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void,\n    executionId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;Array&lt;{ toolCallId: string; toolName: string; content: string }&gt;&gt; {\n    // 判断是否可以并行执行\n    const canParallel = this.canExecuteInParallel(toolCalls, toolConfigs);\n\n    if (canParallel) {\n      // 并行执行工具\n      const promises = toolCalls.map(toolCall =&gt; {\n        const config = toolConfigs.find(t =&gt; t.enabled &amp;&amp; t.name === toolCall.function.name);\n        \n        if (!config) {\n          return Promise.resolve({\n            toolCallId: toolCall.id,\n            toolName: toolCall.function.name,\n            content: JSON.stringify({ error: &#96;工具不存在或已禁用: ${toolCall.function.name}&#96; })\n          });\n        }\n\n        return this.executeSingleTool(toolCall, config, checkTimeout, executionId);\n      });\n\n      const results = await Promise.all(promises);\n      return results;\n    } else {\n      // 串行执行工具（保证顺序，适用于workflow、agent等有依赖的工具）\n      const results: Array&lt;{ toolCallId: string; toolName: string; content: string }&gt; = [];\n\n      for (const toolCall of toolCalls) {\n        // 在每个工具调用前检查超时\n        if (checkTimeout) {\n          checkTimeout();\n        }\n        \n        const config = toolConfigs.find(t =&gt; t.enabled &amp;&amp; t.name === toolCall.function.name);\n        \n        if (!config) {\n          results.push({\n            toolCallId: toolCall.id,\n            toolName: toolCall.function.name,\n            content: JSON.stringify({ error: &#96;工具不存在或已禁用: ${toolCall.function.name}&#96; })\n          });\n          continue;\n        }\n\n        // 使用executeSingleTool方法执行单个工具\n        const result = await this.executeSingleTool(toolCall, config, checkTimeout, executionId);\n        results.push(result);\n      }\n\n      return results;\n    }\n  }\n\n\n  /**\n   * 准备工具定义（转换为 OpenAI Function 格式）\n   */\n  private prepareTools(toolConfigs: ToolConfig[]): Tool[] {\n    return\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行单个工具调用\n   */\n  private async executeSingleTool(\n    toolCall: any,\n    toolConfig: ToolConfig,\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void,\n    executionId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{ toolCallId: string; toolName: string; content: string }&gt; {\n    const TOOL_TIMEOUT = 60000; // 每个工具调用60秒超时\n    const toolCallStartTime = Date.now();\n\n    try {\n      if (checkTimeout) {\n        checkTimeout();\n      }\n\n      const result = await Promise.race([\n        this.toolExecutor.executeTool(toolCall, toolConfig),\n        new Promise&lt;string&gt;((_, reject) =&gt; \n          setTimeout(() =&gt; reject(new Error(&#96;工具调用超时: ${toolCall.function.name} (${TOOL_TIMEOUT / 1000}秒)&#96;)), TOOL_TIMEOUT)\n        )\n      ]);\n      const toolDuration = Date.now() - toolCallStartTime;\n      \n      if (executionId) {\n        await this.logStep(executionId, &#96;tool_${toolCall.function.name}&#96;, {\n          type: 'tool_call',\n          input: { toolName: toolCall.function.name, arguments: toolCall.function.arguments },\n          output: { result },\n          duration: toolDuration,\n          status: 'success'\n        });\n      }\n\n      return {\n        toolCallId: toolCall.id,\n        toolName: toolCall.function.name,\n        content: result\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      const toolDuration = Date.now() - toolCallStartTime;\n      \n      // 标准化错误处理\n      const agentError = AgentErrorHandler.normalizeError\n;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ToolExecutor {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行 Agent 嵌套调用工具\n   */\n  private async executeAgent(toolConfig: ToolConfig, args: any): Promise&lt;ToolExecutionResult&gt; {\n    try {\n      const implementation = toolConfig.implementation;\n      if (!implementation || !implementation.agentId) {\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Agent ID 未配置' })\n        };\n      }\n\n      const agentId = implementation.agentId;\n      const query = args.query || args.input || JSON.stringify(args);\n\n      // 检查调用深度（防止无限递归）\n      const maxDepth = 3;\n      const currentDepth = args._callDepth || 0;\n      if (currentDepth &gt;= maxDepth) {\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          content: JSON.stringify({ \n            error: &#96;Agent嵌套调用深度超过限制: ${maxDepth}&#96;,\n            currentDepth,\n            maxDepth\n          })\n        };\n      }\n\n      // 获取 Agent 配置\n      const agent = await aiRoleModel.getById(agentId);\n      if (!agent || !agent.enabled) {\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: &#96;Agent 不存在或已禁用: ${agentId}&#96; })\n        };\n      }\n\n      // 只支持 Direct Agent 类型的嵌套调用\n      if (agent.provider !== 'direct-agent') {\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          content: JSON.stringify({ \n            error: &#96;Agent ${agentId} 不是 Direct Agent 类型，不支持嵌套调用&#96;,\n            provider: agent.provider\n          })\n        };\n      }\n\n      // 调用 AgentOrchestrator 执行嵌套 Agent\n      const orchestrator = new AgentOrchestrator();\n      \n      // 从args中提取context，但不包括_callDepth\n      const context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = { ...args };\n      delete context._callDepth;\n      delete context.query;\n      delete context.input;\n      \n      // 传递调用深度信息\n      const nestedContext = {\n        ...context,\n        _callDepth: currentDepth + 1\n      };\n\n      const result = await orchestrator.executeAgent\n;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ToolExecutor {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行搜索工具（集成AI Search功能）\n   */\n  private async executeSearch(args: any): Promise&lt;ToolExecutionResult&gt; {\n    try {\n      const query = args.query || '';\n      const limit = args.limit || 10;\n      const filters = args.filters || {};\n      const conversationId = args.conversationId || '';\n\n      if (!query) {\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: '搜索查询不能为空' })\n        };\n      }\n\n      // 调用DifyClient的AI Search功能\n      const difyClient = DifyClient;\n      const inputs: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {\n        ...filters\n      };\n\n      // 如果有限制参数，添加到输入中\n      if (limit &amp;&amp; limit !== 10) {\n        inputs.limit = limit;\n      }\n\n      const result = await difyClient.aiSearch(query, inputs, conversationId);\n\n      // 格式化搜索结果\n      const searchResults = {\n        query,\n        answer: result.answer || '',\n        results: result.metadata?.retriever_resources || [],\n        count: result.metadata?.retriever_resources?.length || 0,\n        sources: (result.metadata?.retriever_resources || []).map((resource: any) =&gt; ({\n          document: resource.document_name || resource.document_id,\n          dataset: resource.dataset_name || resource.dataset_id,\n          content: resource.content,\n          score: resource.score,\n          position: resource.position\n        })),\n        conversationId: result.conversation_id || conversationId,\n        usage: result.metadata?.usage || {}\n      };\n\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        content: JSON.stringify(searchResults)\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        content: JSON.stringify({ \n          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '搜索失败',\n          query: args.query || ''\n        })\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行计算工具（使用mathjs库，安全可靠）\n   */\n  private executeCalculation(args: any): ToolExecutionResult {\n    try\n  }\n}",

error.message : 'API 调用失败' })\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行 Workflow 工具\n   */\n  private async executeWorkflow(toolConfig: ToolConfig, args: any): Promise&lt;ToolExecutionResult&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 判断工具是否可以并行执行\n   */\n  private canExecuteInParallel(toolCalls: any[], toolConfigs: ToolConfig[]): boolean {\n    // 如果只有一个工具调用，不需要并行\n    if (toolCalls.length &lt;= 1) {\n      return false;\n    }\n\n    // 获取所有工具类型\n    const types = toolCalls.map(tc =&gt; {\n      const config = toolConfigs.find(c =&gt; c.name === tc.function.name);\n      return config?.type;\n    });\n\n    // 定义可以并行执行的安全工具类型\n    // 这些工具类型不会相互影响，可以安全地并行执行\n    const parallelSafeTypes = ['search', 'calculation', 'time', 'api'];\n    \n    // 只有当所有工具类型都在安全列表中时，才允许并行执行\n    return types.every(type =&gt; parallelSafeTypes.includes(type || ''));\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行单个工具调用\n   */\n  private async executeSingleTool(\n    toolCall: any,\n    toolConfig: ToolConfig,\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void,\n    executionId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{ toolCallId: string; toolName: string; content: string }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ToolExecutor {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 验证参数\n   */\n  private validateParameters(args: any, parameters: ToolConfig['parameters']): void {\n    for (const param of parameters) {\n      if (param.required &amp;&amp; (args[param.name] === undefined || args[param.name] === null)) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;缺少必需参数: ${param.name}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      // 类型验证\n      if (args[param.name] !== undefined) {\n        const value = args[param.name];\n        const expectedType = param.type;\n\n        switch (expectedType) {\n          case 'string':\n            if (typeof value !== 'string') {\n              throw new Error(&#96;参数 ${param.name} 必须是字符串类型&#96;);\n            }\n            break;\n          case 'number':\n            if (typeof value !== 'number') {\n              throw new Error(&#96;参数 ${param.name} 必须是数字类型&#96;);\n            }\n            break;\n          case 'boolean':\n            if (typeof value !== 'boolean') {\n              throw new Error(&#96;参数 ${param.name} 必须是布尔类型&#96;);\n            }\n            break;\n          case 'array':\n            if (!Array.isArray(value)) {\n              throw new Error(&#96;参数 ${param.name} 必须是数组类型&#96;);\n            }\n            break;\n          case 'object':\n            if (typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value) || value === null) {\n              throw new Error(&#96;参数 ${param.name} 必须是对象类型&#96;);\n            }\n            break;\n        }\n\n        // 枚举值验证\n        if (param.enum &amp;&amp; !param.enum.includes(String(value))) {\n          throw new Error(&#96;参数 ${param.name} 的值必须是以下之一: ${param.enum.join(', ')}&#96;);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行搜索工具（集成AI Search功能）\n   */\n  private async executeSearch(args: any): Promise&lt;ToolExecutionResult&gt; {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\nprivate async executeWithTools(\n    provider: ILLMProvider,\n    messages: ChatMessage[],\n    llmConfig: LLMConfig,\n    tools: Tool[],\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void,\n    executionId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;LLMResponse&gt; {\nwhile (iteration &lt; this.maxToolCallIterations) {\n\n\n      // 将工具调用结果添加到消息历史\n      for (const result of toolResults) {\n        currentMessages.push({\n          role: 'tool',\n          content: result.content,\n          name: result.toolName,\n          tool_call_id: result.toolCallId\n        });\n      }\n\n      iteration++;\n    }\n\n    // 如果达到最大迭代次数，返回最后一次响应\n    if (iteration &gt;= this.maxToolCallIterations) {\n      console.warn(&#96;工具调用达到最大迭代次数: ${this.maxToolCallIterations}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    return lastResponse!;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 判断工具是否可以并行执行\n   */\n  private canExecuteInParallel(toolCalls: any[], toolConfigs: ToolConfig[]): boolean {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\nprivate async executeSingleTool(\n    toolCall: any,\n    toolConfig: ToolConfig,\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void,\n    executionId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{ toolCallId: string; toolName: string; content: string }&gt; {\n\n    } catch (error) {\n      const toolDuration = Date.now() - toolCallStartTime;\n      \n      // 标准化错误处理\n      const agentError = AgentErrorHandler.normalizeError(error, {\n        executionId,\n        step: &#96;tool_${toolCall.function.name}&#96;\n      });\n      \n      console.error(&#96;工具执行失败: ${toolCall.function.name}&#96;, agentError);\n      \n      if (executionId) {\n        await this.logStep(executionId, &#96;tool_${toolCall.function.name}_error&#96;, {\n          type: 'tool_call',\n          input: { toolName: toolCall.function.name, arguments: toolCall.function.arguments },\n          output: null,\n          duration: toolDuration,\n          status: 'failed',\n          error: agentError.message,\n          errorCode: agentError.code,\n          errorDetails: agentError.details\n        });\n      }\n\n      // 返回标准化的错误信息（不抛出异常，让LLM决定如何处理）\n      return {\n        toolCallId: toolCall.id,\n        toolName: toolCall.function.name,\n        content: JSON.stringify({ \n          error: agentError.message,\n          errorCode: agentError.code,\n          recoverable: agentError.recoverable,\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\n          details: agentError.details\n        })\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行多个工具调用（支持并行执行）\n   */\n  private async executeTools(\n    toolCalls: any[],\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void,\n    executionId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;Array&lt;{ toolCallId: string; toolName: string; content: string }&gt;&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ToolExecutor {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行计算工具（使用mathjs库，安全可靠）\n   */\n  private executeCalculation(args: any): ToolExecutionResult {\n    try {\n      const expression = args.expression || '';\n\n      if (!expression) {\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: '计算表达式不能为空' })\n        };\n      }\n\n      try {\n        // 使用mathjs进行安全的数学表达式计算\n        // mathjs会解析并验证表达式，只允许数学运算，防止代码注入\n        const result = evaluate(expression);\n\n        // 验证结果是否为有效数字\n        if (typeof result !== 'number' || !isFinite(result)) {\n          return {\n            success: false,\n            content: JSON.stringify({ error: '计算结果不是有效数字', result })\n          };\n        }\n\n        return {\n          success: true,\n          content: JSON.stringify({\n            expression,\n            result\n          })\n        };\n      } catch (error) {\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          content: JSON.stringify({ \n            error: '表达式计算失败: ' + (error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'),\n            expression\n          })\n        };\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        content: JSON.stringify({ error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '计算失败' })\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取时间工具\n   */\n  private getTime(args: any): ToolExecutionResult {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentErrorHandler {\nstatic normalizeError(\n    error: any,\n    context?: {\n      roleId?: string;\n      executionId?: string;\n      step?: string;\n    }\n  ): AgentError {\n\n        }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // 限流错误\n    if (\n      errorMessage.includes('429') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('rate limit') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('限流')\n    ) {\n      return new AgentError(\n        AgentErrorCode.RATE_LIMIT_ERROR,\n        '请求频率过高，请稍后重试',\n        {\n          recoverable: true,\n          details: error,\n          context\n        }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // 配置错误\n    if (\n      errorMessage.includes('不存在') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('未配置') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('not found') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('missing')\n    ) {\n      return new AgentError(\n        AgentErrorCode.CONFIG_ERROR,\n        errorMessage || '配置错误',\n        {\n          recoverable: false,\n          details: error,\n          context\n        }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // 验证错误\n    if (\n      errorMessage.includes('验证') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('validation') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('invalid')\n    ) {\n      return new AgentError(\n        AgentErrorCode.VALIDATION_ERROR,\n        errorMessage || '参数验证失败',\n        {\n          recoverable: false,\n          details: error,\n          context\n        }\n      );\n (\n      errorMessage.includes('工具') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('tool') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('Tool')\n    ) {\n      return new AgentError(\n        AgentErrorCode.TOOL_ERROR,\n        errorMessage || '工具执行失败',\n        {\n          recoverable: true,\n          details: error,\n          context\n        }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // 未知错误\n    return\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\nasync executeAgent(\n    roleId: string,\n    query: string,\n    conversationId: string = '',\n    context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt; {\n\n    \n    try {\n      // 1. 获取 Agent 配置\n      checkTimeout();\n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'load_config', {\n        type: 'config',\n        input: { roleId },\n        output: null,\n        duration: 0,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n\n      const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\n      if (!role) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;AI角色不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      if (!role.agentConfig) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;Agent配置不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      const config = role.agentConfig;\n\n      // 2. 生成或使用 conversationId\n      const finalConversationId = conversationId || this.generateConversationId();\n\n      // 3. 检查 prompt 配置\n      if (!config.prompt) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;Agent prompt配置不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      if (!config.prompt.systemPrompt) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;Agent systemPrompt配置不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      // 4. 渲染 System Prompt\n      const promptStartTime = Date.now();\n      const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\n        config.prompt.systemPrompt,\n        config.prompt.variables || [],\n        context\n      );\n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'render_prompt', {\n        type: 'prompt',\n        input: { systemPrompt: config.prompt.systemPrompt, variables: config.prompt.variables, context },\n        output: { systemPrompt },\n        duration: Date.now() - promptStartTime,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n\n      // 4. 获取上下文消息\n      checkTimeout();\n      const contextStartTime = Date.now();\n      const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\n        finalConversationId,\n        config.contextStrategy,\n        query\n      );\n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'load_context', {\n        type: 'context',\n        input:\n\n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export class ToolExecutor {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取时间工具\n   */\n  private getTime(args: any): ToolExecutionResult {\n    try {\n      const format = args.format || 'iso'; // iso, timestamp, date, time\n      const timezone = args.timezone || 'Asia/Shanghai';\n\n      const now = new Date();\n      let result: any = {};\n\n      switch (format) {\n        case 'iso':\n          result.iso = now.toISOString();\n          result.local = now.toLocaleString('zh-CN', { timeZone: timezone });\n          break;\n        case 'timestamp':\n          result.timestamp = now.getTime();\n          result.unix = Math.floor(now.getTime() / 1000);\n          break;\n        case 'date':\n          result.date = now.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN', { timeZone: timezone });\n          result.year = now.getFullYear();\n          result.month = now.getMonth() + 1;\n          result.day = now.getDate();\n          break;\n        case 'time':\n          result.time = now.toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN', { timeZone: timezone });\n          result.hour = now.getHours();\n          result.minute = now.getMinutes();\n          result.second = now.getSeconds();\n          break;\n        default:\n          result = {\n            iso: now.toISOString(),\n            timestamp: now.getTime(),\n            local: now.toLocaleString('zh-CN', { timeZone: timezone })\n          };\n      }\n\n      result.timezone = timezone;\n      result.format = format;\n\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        content: JSON.stringify(result)\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        content: JSON.stringify({ error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '获取时间失败' })\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行 API 调用工具\n   */\n  private async executeAPI(toolConfig: ToolConfig, args: any): Promise&lt;ToolExecutionResult&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行带工具调用的 LLM 请求（可能多轮）\n   */\n  private async executeWithTools(\n    provider: ILLMProvider,\n    messages: ChatMessage[],\n    llmConfig: LLMConfig,\n    tools: Tool[],\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void,\n    executionId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;LLMResponse&gt; {\n    let iteration = 0;\n    let currentMessages = [...messages];\n    let lastResponse: LLMResponse;\n\n    while (iteration &lt; this.maxToolCallIterations) {\n      // 检查超时\n      if (checkTimeout) {\n        checkTimeout();\n      }\n      \n      // 调用 LLM\n      const response = await provider.chat(currentMessages, llmConfig, tools.length &gt; 0 ? tools : undefined);\n      lastResponse = response;\n\n      // LLM 调用后检查超时\n      if (checkTimeout) {\n        checkTimeout();\n      }\n\n      // 如果没有工具调用，直接返回\n      if (!response.toolCalls || response.toolCalls.length === 0) {\n        return response;\n      }\n\n      // 将 assistant 的回复添加到消息历史\n      currentMessages.push({\n        role: 'assistant',\n        content: response.content || ''\n      });\n\n      // 执行工具调用（检查超时）\n      if (checkTimeout) {\n        checkTimeout();\n      }\n      const toolStartTime = Date.now();\n      const toolResults = await this.executeTools(response.toolCalls, toolConfigs, checkTimeout, executionId);\n      if (executionId) {\n        await this.logStep(executionId, &#96;tool_execution_${iteration}&#96;, {\n          type: 'tool',\n          input: { toolCalls: response.toolCalls },\n          output: { results: toolResults },\n          duration: Date.now() - toolStartTime,\n          status: 'success'\n        });\n      }\n\n      // 工具执行后检查超时\n      if (checkTimeout) {\n        checkTimeout();\n      }\n\n      // 将工具调用结果添加到消息历史\n      for (const result of\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "### ChatCompletionResponse\n\n- 返回完整的 App 结果，&#96;Content-Type&#96; 为 &#96;application/json&#96;。\n    \n    - &#96;event&#96; (string) 事件类型，固定为 &#96;message&#96;\n        \n    - &#96;task_id&#96; (string) 任务 ID，用于请求跟踪和下方的停止响应接口\n        \n    - &#96;id&#96; (string) 唯一ID\n        \n    - &#96;message_id&#96; (string) 消息唯一 ID\n        \n    - &#96;conversation_id&#96; (string) 会话 ID\n        \n    - &#96;mode&#96; (string) App 模式，固定为 chat\n        \n    - &#96;answer&#96; (string) 完整回复内容\n        \n    - &#96;metadata&#96; (object) 元数据\n        \n        - &#96;usage&#96; (Usage) 模型用量信息\n            \n        - &#96;retriever_resources&#96; (array[RetrieverResource]) 引用和归属分段列表\n            \n    - &#96;created_at&#96; (int) 消息创建时间戳，如：1705395332\n        \n\n### ChunkChatCompletionResponse\n\n- 返回 App 输出的流式块，&#96;Content-Type&#96; 为 &#96;text/event-stream&#96;。 每个流式块均为 data: 开头，块之间以 \\n\\n 即两个换行符分隔，如下所示：\n    \n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;Plain\ndata: {\"event\": \"message\", \"task_id\": \"900bbd43-dc0b-4383-a372-aa6e6c414227\", \"id\": \"663c5084-a254-4040-8ad3-51f2a3c1a77c\", \"answer\": \"Hi\", \"created_at\": 1705398420}\\n\\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n- CopyCopied!\n    \n- 流式块中根据 event 不同，结构也不同：\n    \n    - &#96;event: message&#96; LLM 返回文本块事件，即：完整的文本以分块的方式输出。\n        ",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行单个工具调用\n   */\n  private async executeSingleTool(\n    toolCall: any,\n    toolConfig: ToolConfig,\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void,\n    executionId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{ toolCallId: string; toolName: string; content: string }&gt; {\n    const TOOL_TIMEOUT = 60000; // 每个工具调用60秒超时\n    const toolCallStartTime = Date.now();\n\n    try {\n      if (checkTimeout) {\n        checkTimeout();\n      }\n\n      const result = await Promise.race([\n        this.toolExecutor.executeTool(toolCall, toolConfig),\n        new Promise&lt;string&gt;((_, reject) =&gt; \n          setTimeout(() =&gt; reject(new Error(&#96;工具调用超时: ${toolCall.function.name} (${TOOL_TIMEOUT / 1000}秒)&#96;)), TOOL_TIMEOUT)\n        )\n      ]);\n      const toolDuration = Date.now() - toolCallStartTime;\n      \n      if (executionId) {\n        await this.logStep(executionId, &#96;tool_${toolCall.function.name}&#96;, {\n          type: 'tool_call',\n          input: { toolName: toolCall.function.name, arguments: toolCall.function.arguments },\n          output: { result },\n          duration: toolDuration,\n          status: 'success'\n        });\n      }\n\n      return {\n        toolCallId: toolCall.id,\n        toolName: toolCall.function.name,\n        content: result\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      const toolDuration = Date.now() - toolCallStartTime;\n      \n      // 标准化错误处理\n      const agentError = AgentErrorHandler.normalizeError\n;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class OpenAIProvider implements ILLMProvider {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 发送聊天请求\n   */\n  async chat(messages: ChatMessage[], config: LLMConfig, tools?: Tool[]): Promise&lt;LLMResponse&gt; {\n    const url = &#96;${this.apiBaseUrl}/chat/completions&#96;;\n    \n    // Check if model requires max_completion_tokens (e.g., o1 series, gpt-5.1)\n    const isReasoningModel = config.model.startsWith('o1') || config.model.startsWith('o3') || config.model === 'gpt-5.1';\n\n    const requestBody: any = {\n      model: config.model,\n      messages: this.formatMessages(messages),\n      temperature: config.temperature,\n    };\n\n    if (isReasoningModel) {\n      requestBody.max_completion_tokens = config.maxTokens;\n    } else {\n      requestBody.max_tokens = config.maxTokens;\n    }\n\n    if (config.topP !== undefined) {\n      requestBody.top_p = config.topP;\n    }\n\n    // 支持 stream 参数\n    // 注意：如果 stream=true，API 会返回 SSE 流，需要特殊处理\n    // 当前实现仅支持非流式响应（stream=false 或未设置）\n    if (config.stream !== undefined &amp;&amp; config.stream === true) {\n      // 流式响应需要特殊处理，当前暂不支持，强制设置为 false\n      // TODO: 实现流式响应处理逻辑\n      requestBody.stream = false;\n    } else if (config.stream !== undefined) {\n      requestBody.stream = config.stream;\n    }\n\n    // 添加工具定义（如果提供）\n    if (tools &amp;&amp; tools.length &gt; 0) {\n      requestBody.tools = tools;\n      requestBody.tool_choice = 'auto';\n    }\n\n    let lastError: Error | null = null;\n    \n    // 重试逻辑\n    for (let attempt = 0; attempt &lt; this.maxRetries; attempt++) {\n      try\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AnthropicProvider implements ILLMProvider {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 发送聊天请求\n   */\n  async chat(messages: ChatMessage[], config: LLMConfig, tools?: Tool[]): Promise&lt;LLMResponse&gt; {\n    const url = &#96;${this.apiBaseUrl}/messages&#96;;\n\n    // Anthropic API 要求 system 消息单独传递\n    const systemMessages = messages.filter(m =&gt; m.role === 'system');\n    const conversationMessages = messages.filter(m =&gt; m.role !== 'system');\n    const system = systemMessages.length &gt; 0 \n      ? systemMessages.map(m =&gt; m.content).join('\\n')\n      : undefined;\n\n    // 转换消息格式为 Anthropic 格式\n    const anthropicMessages = conversationMessages.map(msg =&gt; {\n      if (msg.role === 'tool') {\n        // Anthropic 使用 assistant 消息类型处理 tool 响应\n        return {\n          role: 'assistant' as const,\n          content: &#96;Tool ${msg.name} (${msg.tool_call_id}) returned: ${msg.content}&#96;\n        };\n      }\n      return {\n        role: msg.role === 'assistant' ? 'assistant' as const : 'user' as const,\n        content: msg.content\n      };\n    });\n\n    // 转换工具为 Anthropic 格式\n    let toolsConfig: any = undefined;\n    if (tools &amp;&amp; tools.length &gt; 0) {\n      toolsConfig = {\n        tools: tools.map(tool =&gt; ({\n          name: tool.function.name,\n          description: tool.function.description,\n          input_schema: tool.function.parameters\n        }))\n      };\n    }\n\n    const requestBody: any = {\n      model: config.model,\n      max_tokens: config.maxTokens,\n      messages: anthropicMessages\n    };\n\n    if (system) {\n      requestBody.system = system;\n    }\n\n    if (config.temperature !== undefined) {\n      requestBody.temperature = config.temperature;\n    }\n\n    if (toolsConfig) {\n      requestBody.tools = toolsConfig.tools;\n      requestBody.tool_choice = { type: 'auto' };\n    }\n\n    let lastError: Error | null = null;\n    \n    // 重试逻辑\n    for (let attempt = 0; attempt &lt; this.maxRetries; attempt++) {\n      try\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 工具执行器\n * 负责执行各种类型的工具调用\n */\nexport class ToolExecutor {\n  constructor() {\n    // AgentWorkflowService 已被移除，使用 LangGraphEngine 替代\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行工具调用\n   * @param toolCall 工具调用信息\n   * @param toolConfig 工具配置\n   * @returns 执行结果（JSON 字符串）\n   */\n  async executeTool(toolCall: ToolCall, toolConfig: ToolConfig): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 解析参数\n      const args = JSON.parse(toolCall.function.arguments || '{}');\n\n      // 验证参数\n      this.validateParameters(args, toolConfig.parameters);\n\n      // 根据工具类型执行\n      let result: ToolExecutionResult;\n\n      switch (toolConfig.type) {\n        case 'search':\n          result = await this.executeSearch(args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'calculation':\n          result = this.executeCalculation(args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'time':\n          result = this.getTime(args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'api':\n          result = await this.executeAPI(toolConfig, args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'workflow':\n          result = await this.executeWorkflow(toolConfig, args);\n          break;\n\n        case 'agent':\n          result = await this.executeAgent(toolConfig, args);\n          break;\n\n        default:\n          result = {\n            success: false,\n            content: JSON.stringify({ error: &#96;不支持的工具类型: ${toolConfig.type}&#96; })\n          };\n      }\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return JSON.stringify({ error: result.error || '工具执行失败' });\n      }\n\n      return result.content;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(&#96;工具执行失败: ${toolConfig.name}&#96;, error);\n      return JSON.stringify({\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '工具执行失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {

          }
        },
        "contents": "3.  **Context Sync (同步回左侧)**:\n    *   主 Agent 感知到用户修改了数据。\n    *   主 Agent: \"明白了，峰值电流是 600A。那这个充电速度很快。接下来我们看看**场景**。用户最痛的场景是什么？\"\n    *   *(界面显示: 正在调用 &#96;Consult_Scenario_Alchemist&#96;...)*\n\n4.  **Scenario Generation (右侧切换)**:\n    *   右侧面板切换为 **Scenario View**。\n    *   展示卡片: \"高速服务区抢桩\"、\"冬天续航打折\"、\"急事出门发现没电\"。\n\n5.  **Final Output (交付)**:\n    *   主 Agent 综合所有信息，在右侧生成最终的《短视频分镜脚本》。\n\n---\n\n### 4. 技术实现方案 (Technical Implementation)\n\n#### Frontend (Next.js / React)\n*   **State Management**: 使用 &#96;useReducer&#96; 或 &#96;Zustand&#96; 维护一个全局 &#96;AgentState&#96;。\n    &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n    interface AgentState {\n      messages: Message[]; // 左侧对话历史\n      activeTool: 'tech' | 'scenario' | 'market' | 'content' | null; // 当前激活的工具\n      toolOutputs: {\n        techData: TechParams;\n        scenarios: ScenarioCard[];\n        strategy: StrategyDoc;\n        finalContent: string;\n      }; // 右侧面板的数据\n    }\n    &#96;&#96;&#96;\n*   **Components**:\n    *   &#96;&lt;ChatStream /&gt;&#96;: 渲染对话流，支持 Markdown。\n    *   &#96;&lt;ToolPanel /&gt;&#96;: 根据 &#96;activeTool&#96; 渲染不同的子组件。\n\n#### Backend (LangGraph / Python)\n*   **Graph Design**:\n    *   **Main Node**: 负责对话管理、意图识别、工具分发。\n    *   **Tool Nodes**: \n        *   &#96;tech_node&#96;: 执行技术提取 Prompt。\n        *   &#96;scene_node&#96;: 执行场景生成 Prompt。\n    *   **State Sync**: 每次 Tool Node 执行完，不仅返回结果给 Main Node，还通过 SSE (Server-Sent Events) 推送结构化数据给前端，更新右侧面板。\n\n---\n\n### 5. 下一步行动建议\n\n如果您同意这个方案，我们可以：\n1.  **创建原型**: 我可以为您写一个简单的 React 组件结构代码，展示左右分栏和状态联动的逻辑。\n2.  **定义 API**: 确定前端和后端交互的数据结构 (Schema)。",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nasync execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n        // 记录保存的消息内容\n        logger.info('保存AI消息', {\n          workflowId: finalWorkflowId,\n          content: aiContent,\n          contentLength: aiContent.length,\n          outputsContent: cleanExtractedOutput.content,\n          outputsKeys: Object.keys(cleanExtractedOutput),\n        });\n\n        const aiMessageRecord = await this.aiSearchService.sendMessage(\n          params.conversationId,\n          'assistant',\n          aiContent,\n          params.sources || [],\n          [],\n          cleanExtractedOutput\n        );\n        \n        logger.info('AI消息已保存', {\n          messageId: aiMessageRecord.id,\n          content: aiMessageRecord.content,\n          contentLength: aiMessageRecord.content?.length || 0,\n        });\n\n        return success({\n          userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n          aiMessage: formatMessageRecord(aiMessageRecord),\n        });\n      } catch (workflowError: any) {\n        logger.error('工作流执行失败', { workflowError });\n        return success({\n          userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n          error: '工作流执行失败，请稍后重试',\n          errorDetail: workflowError?.message || String(workflowError),\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('发送消息失败', { error });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'SEND_MESSAGE_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '发送消息失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取功能类型的中文标签\n   */\n  private getFeatureLabel(featureType: string): string {\n    const labelMap: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n      'five-view-analysis': '五看分析'\n,\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "## 工作流编排对话型应用 API\n\n对话应用支持会话持久化，可将之前的聊天记录作为上下文进行回答，可适用于聊天/客服 AI 等。\n\n### 基础 URL\n\n### Code\n\nhttp://47.113.225.93:9999/v1\n\nCopyCopied!\n\n### 鉴权\n\nService API 使用 &#96;API-Key&#96; 进行鉴权。 _强烈建议开发者把_ _&#96;API-Key&#96;_ _放在后端存储，而非分享或者放在客户端存储，以免_ _&#96;API-Key&#96;_ _泄露，导致财产损失。_ 所有 API 请求都应在 &#96;Authorization&#96; HTTP Header 中包含您的 &#96;API-Key&#96;，如下所示：\n\n### Code\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;JavaScript\n  Authorization: Bearer {API_KEY}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCopyCopied!\n\n---\n\nPOST/chat-messages\n\n## [发送对话消息](http://47.113.225.93:9999/app/a541096e-d0c1-48f8-98af-df593cf62428/develop#Create-Chat-Message)\n\n创建会话消息。\n\n### Request Body\n\n- Name&#96;query&#96;TypestringDescription\n    \n- 用户输入/提问内容。\n    \n- Name&#96;inputs&#96;TypeobjectDescription\n    \n- 允许传入 App 定义的各变量值。 inputs 参数包含了多组键值对（Key/Value pairs），每组的键对应一个特定变量，每组的值则是该变量的具体值。 如果变量是文件类型，请指定一个包含以下 &#96;files&#96; 中所述键的对象。 默认 &#96;{}&#96;\n    \n- Name&#96;response_mode&#96;TypestringDescription\n    \n    - &#96;streaming&#96; 流式模式（推荐）。基于 SSE（[Server-Sent Events](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events/Using_server-sent_events)）实现类似打字机输出方式的流式返回。\n        \n    - &#96;blocking&#96; 阻塞模式，等待执行完毕后返回结果。（请求若流程较长可能会被中断）。 _由于 Cloudflare 限制，请求会在 100 秒超时无返回后中断。_\n        \n- Name&#96;user&#96;TypestringDescription\n    \n- 用户标识，用于定义终端用户的身份，方便检索、统计。 由开发者定义规则，需保证用户标识在应用内唯一。服务 API 不会共享 WebApp 创建的对话。\n    \n- Name&#96;conversation_id&#96;TypestringDescription\n    ",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "### 基础 URL",

          {

            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "CopyCopied!",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "### 鉴权",

            "lineNumber": 19

          {

          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

        "contents": "export class WorkflowEngine {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行单个节点\n   */\n  private async executeNode(\n    workflow: AgentWorkflow,\n    node: AgentWorkflowNode,\n    options: Required&lt;WorkflowExecutionOptions&gt;\n  ): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    const nodeResult = this.execution!.nodeResults.find(r =&gt; r.nodeId === node.id);\n    if (!nodeResult) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    nodeResult.status = 'running';\n    nodeResult.startTime = new Date();\n    this.notifyProgress();\n\n    try {\n      // 准备节点输入\n      const nodeInput = await this.prepareNodeInput(workflow, node, this.execution!.sharedContext);\n      nodeResult.input = nodeInput;\n\n      let output: any;\n\n      // 根据节点类型执行不同的逻辑\n      switch (node.type) {\n        case 'agent':\n          output = await this.executeAgentNode(node, nodeInput);\n          break;\n        case 'condition':\n          output = await this.executeConditionNode(node, nodeInput);\n          break;\n        case 'assign':\n          output = await this.executeAssignNode(node, nodeInput);\n          break;\n        case 'merge':\n          output = await this.executeMergeNode(node, workflow);\n          break;\n        case 'transform':\n          output = await this.executeTransformNode(node, nodeInput);\n          break;\n        case 'input':\n          output = await this.executeInputNode(node, options.input);\n          break;\n        case 'output':\n          output = await this.executeOutputNode(node, workflow);\n          break;\n        case 'memory':\n          output = await this.executeMemoryNode(node, workflow);\n          break;\n        default:\n          throw new Error(&#96;不支持的节点类型: ${node.type}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      nodeResult.status = 'completed';\n      nodeResult.output = output;\n      nodeResult.endTime = new Date();\n      nodeResult.duration = nodeResult.endTime.getTime() - nodeResult.startTime.getTime();\n\n      // 将输出保存到共享上下文\n      this.execution!.sharedContext.nodeOutputs[node.id] = output;\n\n    } catch (error) {\n      nodeResult.status = 'failed';\n      nodeResult.endTime = new Date();\n      nodeResult.duration =\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "sequenceDiagram\n    participant U as 用户\n    participant F as 前端应用\n    participant B as 后端服务\n    participant D as Dify API\n    participant DB as 数据库\n    \n    U-&gt;&gt;F: 提交工作流请求\n    F-&gt;&gt;F: 表单验证\n    F-&gt;&gt;B: POST /api/workflows/{type}/run\n    B-&gt;&gt;B: 参数验证和映射\n    B-&gt;&gt;DB: 创建任务记录\n    B-&gt;&gt;D: 调用工作流API\n    \n    alt 流式响应\n        D--&gt;&gt;B: 流式数据块\n        B--&gt;&gt;F: SSE 事件流\n        F--&gt;&gt;U: 实时更新界面\n    else 阻塞响应\n        D-&gt;&gt;B: 完整结果\n        B-&gt;&gt;DB: 更新任务状态\n        B-&gt;&gt;F: 返回结果\n        F-&gt;&gt;U: 显示最终结果\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 数据流转图\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart LR\n    A[用户输入] --&gt; B[前端验证]\n    B --&gt; C[API请求]\n    C --&gt; D[后端验证]\n    D --&gt; E[字段映射]\n    E --&gt; F[工作流执行]\n    F --&gt; G[结果处理]\n    G --&gt; H[数据存储]\n    H --&gt; I[响应返回]\n    I --&gt; J[前端展示]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 🔒 安全架构\n\n### 安全措施\n1. **输入验证**: 使用 Zod 进行运行时类型验证\n2. **CORS 配置**: 限制跨域访问来源\n3. **请求限制**: 实现 API 调用频率限制\n4. **错误处理**: 避免敏感信息泄露\n5. **日志记录**: 记录关键操作和异常\n\n### 安全配置示例\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// api/middleware/security.ts\nexport const securityMiddleware = [\n  helmet({\n    contentSecurityPolicy: {\n      directives: {\n        defaultSrc: [\"'self'\"],\n        styleSrc: [\"'self'\", \"'unsafe-inline'\"],\n        scriptSrc: [\"'self'\"],\n        imgSrc: [\"'self'\", \"data:\", \"https:\"]\n      }\n    }\n  }),\n  \n  rateLimit({\n    windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, // 15分钟\n    max: 100, // 限制每个IP 100次请求\n    message: 'Too many requests from this IP'\n  }),\n  \n  (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) =&gt; {\n    // 请求日志\n    logger.info(&#96;${req.method} ${req.path}&#96;, {\n      ip: req.ip,\n      userAgent: req.get('User-Agent')\n    });\n    next();\n  }\n];\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## ⚡ 性能优化\n\n### 前端优化\n1. **代码分割**: 使用 React.lazy 和 Suspense\n2. **缓存策略**: 实现智能缓存机制",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行多个工具调用（支持并行执行）\n   */\n  private async executeTools(\n    toolCalls: any[],\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void,\n    executionId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;Array&lt;{ toolCallId: string; toolName: string; content: string }&gt;&gt; {\n    // 判断是否可以并行执行\n    const canParallel = this.canExecuteInParallel(toolCalls, toolConfigs);\n\n    if (canParallel) {\n      // 并行执行工具\n      const promises = toolCalls.map(toolCall =&gt; {\n        const config = toolConfigs.find(t =&gt; t.enabled &amp;&amp; t.name === toolCall.function.name);\n        \n        if (!config) {\n          return Promise.resolve({\n            toolCallId: toolCall.id,\n            toolName: toolCall.function.name,\n            content: JSON.stringify({ error: &#96;工具不存在或已禁用: ${toolCall.function.name}&#96; })\n          });\n        }\n\n        return this.executeSingleTool(toolCall, config, checkTimeout, executionId);\n      });\n\n      const results = await Promise.all(promises);\n      return results;\n    } else {\n      // 串行执行工具（保证顺序，适用于workflow、agent等有依赖的工具）\n      const results: Array&lt;{ toolCallId: string; toolName: string; content: string }&gt; = [];\n\n      for (const toolCall of toolCalls) {\n        // 在每个工具调用前检查超时\n        if (checkTimeout) {\n          checkTimeout();\n        }\n        \n        const config = toolConfigs.find(t =&gt; t.enabled &amp;&amp; t.name === toolCall.function.name);\n        \n        if (!config) {\n          results.push({\n            toolCallId: toolCall.id,\n            toolName: toolCall.function.name,\n            content: JSON.stringify({ error: &#96;工具不存在或已禁用: ${toolCall.function.name}&#96; })\n          });\n          continue;\n        }\n\n        // 使用executeSingleTool方法执行单个工具\n        const result = await this.executeSingleTool(toolCall, config, checkTimeout, executionId);\n        results.push(result);\n      }\n\n      return results;\n    }\n  }\n\n\n  /**\n   * 准备工具定义（转换为 OpenAI Function 格式）\n   */\n  private prepareTools(toolConfigs: ToolConfig[]): Tool[] {\n    return\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\nasync executeAgent(\n    roleId: string,\n    query: string,\n    conversationId: string = '',\n    context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt; {\n\n\n      // 10. 返回结果\n      const totalDuration = Date.now() - startTime;\n      \n      // 记录总体执行时间\n      await this.recordPerformanceMetrics(executionId, 'execution_time', totalDuration, { \n        roleId, \n        toolCalls: response.toolCalls?.length || 0 \n      });\n      \n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'complete', {\n        type: 'complete',\n        input: { query },\n        output: { content: response.content },\n        duration: totalDuration,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n\n      return {\n        content: response.content,\n        conversationId: finalConversationId,\n        usage: response.usage,\n        metadata: {\n          model: response.model,\n          finishReason: response.finishReason,\n          toolCalls: response.toolCalls?.length || 0,\n          executionId\n        }\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      const totalDuration = Date.now() - startTime;\n      \n      // 标准化错误处理\n      const agentError = AgentErrorHandler.normalizeError(error, {\n        roleId,\n        executionId,\n        step: 'executeAgent'\n      });\n      \n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'error', {\n        type: 'error',\n        input: { query, context },\n        output: null,\n        duration: totalDuration,\n        status: 'failed',\n        error: agentError.message,\n        errorCode: agentError.code,\n        errorDetails: agentError.details\n      });\n      \n      // 抛出标准化的错误\n      throw agentError;\n    } finally {\n      this.currentExecutionId = '';\n      this.currentAgentId = '';\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 执行带工具调用的 LLM 请求（可能多轮）\n   */\n  private async executeWithTools(\n    provider: ILLMProvider,\n    messages: ChatMessage[],\n    llmConfig: LLMConfig,\n    tools: Tool[],\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\n    checkTimeout?: () =&gt; void,\n    executionId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;LLMResponse&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nasync execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n\n        const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, mappingConfig.inputMappings);\n\n        // 获取对话的 Dify conversation_id（如果存在），用于多轮对话\n        const difyConversationId = conversationRecord?.difyConversationId || null;\n        \n        logger.info('准备发送消息到Dify工作流', {\n          本地对话ID: params.conversationId,\n          DifyConversationId: difyConversationId || '未设置（首次对话，Dify将返回新的conversation_id）',\n        });\n        \n        // 将 Dify conversation_id 添加到 workflowInput 中，这样 Agent 节点可以获取到\n        if (difyConversationId) {\n          workflowInput.conversationId = difyConversationId;\n          logger.info('已设置Dify conversation_id到工作流输入', { difyConversationId });\n        } else {\n          logger.info('首次对话，未设置Dify conversation_id，Dify将创建新的对话');\n        }\n\n        // 判断 finalWorkflowId 是 AI 角色 ID 还是工作流 ID\n        // AI 角色 ID 可能以 'role_' 或 'ai-role-' 开头\n        const isRoleId = finalWorkflowId.startsWith('role_') || finalWorkflowId.startsWith('ai-role-');\n        \n        let workflowResult;\n        if (isRoleId) {\n          // 直接调用 AI 角色\n          logger.info('检测到 AI 角色 ID，直接调用角色', { roleId: finalWorkflowId });\n          workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeRole(finalWorkflowId, {\n            input: workflowInput,\n          });\n        } else {\n          // 通过工作流调用\n          logger.info('检测到工作流 ID，通过工作流调用', { workflowId: finalWorkflowId });\n          workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(finalWorkflowId, {\n            input: workflowInput,\n          });\n        }\n\n        // 检查执行结果\n        if\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ToolExecutor {\nprivate async executeAgent(toolConfig: ToolConfig, args: any): Promise&lt;ToolExecutionResult&gt; {\n\n          };\n        }\n        targetAgentId = implementation.agentId;\n        useDify = false; // 默认使用 Direct Agent\n      }\n\n      if (!targetAgentId) {\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: '无法确定目标 Agent ID' })\n        };\n      }\n\n      // 构建查询内容\n      let query = args.query || args.input || '';\n      if (!query) {\n        // 如果没有 query，根据工具类型构建查询\n        if (toolConfig.name === 'Consult_Tech') {\n          query = args.techDocument || '请分析以下技术文档';\n        } else if (toolConfig.name === 'Consult_Scene') {\n          query = &#96;请分析技术点 \"${args.techPoint || ''}\" 的用户场景&#96;;\n        } else if (toolConfig.name === 'Consult_Market') {\n          query = &#96;请分析技术 \"${args.techDescription || ''}\" 的市场策略&#96;;\n        } else if (toolConfig.name === 'Consult_Content') {\n          query = &#96;请生成 ${args.contentType || 'script'} 类型的内容&#96;;\n        } else {\n          query = JSON.stringify(args);\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 检查调用深度（防止无限递归）\n      const maxDepth = 3;\n      const currentDepth = args._callDepth || 0;\n      if (currentDepth &gt;= maxDepth) {\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          content:\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\nasync executeAgent(\n    roleId: string,\n    query: string,\n    conversationId: string = '',\n    context: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {}\n  ): Promise&lt;AgentExecutionResult&gt; {\nconst contextMessages = await \n\n      );\n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'load_context', {\n        type: 'context',\n        input: { conversationId: finalConversationId, strategy: config.contextStrategy, query },\n        output: { messageCount: contextMessages.length },\n        duration: Date.now() - contextStartTime,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n\n      // 5. 检查 contextStrategy 配置\n      if (!config.contextStrategy) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;Agent contextStrategy配置不存在: ${roleId}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      // 6. 构建完整消息列表\n      const messages: ChatMessage[] = [];\n      \n      // 根据策略决定是否包含 system prompt\n      if (config.contextStrategy.includeSystemPrompt || contextMessages.length === 0) {\n        messages.push({\n          role: 'system',\n          content: systemPrompt\n        });\n      }\n\n      messages.push(...contextMessages);\n      messages.push({\n        role: 'user',\n        content: query\n      });\n\n      // 6. 准备工具定义（Function Calling）\n      const tools = this.prepareTools(config.tools || []);\n\n      // 7. 获取 LLM Provider\n      const provider = this.getProvider(config.llm);\n\n      // 8. 调用 LLM（可能包含多轮工具调用）\n      checkTimeout();\n      const llmStartTime = Date.now();\n      let response = await this.executeWithTools(provider, messages, config.llm, tools, config.tools || [], checkTimeout, executionId);\n      const llmDuration = Date.now() - llmStartTime;\n      \n      // 记录性能指标\n      await this.recordPerformanceMetrics(executionId, 'llm_call', llmDuration, response.usage);\n      \n      await this.logStep(executionId, 'llm_call', {\n        type: 'llm',\n        input: { messageCount: messages.length, toolCount: tools.length },\n        output: { content: response.content, toolCalls: response.toolCalls?.length || 0 },\n        duration: llmDuration,\n        status: 'success'\n      });\n\n      // 9. 保存消息历史\n      await this.saveMessages(finalConversationId, query, response, roleId);\n\n      // 10. 返回结果\n      const totalDuration = Date.now() - startTime;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TechArticleAggregationService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 聚合多个数据源并生成多版本通稿\n   */\n  async aggregateAndGenerate(options: AggregateOptions): Promise&lt;MultiVersionArticle&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 1. 收集所有来源数据\n      const sourceData = await this.collectSourceData(\n        options.conversationIds,\n        options.outputIds\n      );\n\n      // 2. 构建工作流输入\n      const workflowInput = this.buildWorkflowInput(sourceData, options);\n\n      // 3. 解析工作流ID（从环境变量或配置）\n      const workflowId = options.workflowId || process.env.TECH_ARTICLE_WORKFLOW_ID || null;\n      if (!workflowId) {\n        throw new Error('未配置技术通稿工作流ID，请设置 TECH_ARTICLE_WORKFLOW_ID 环境变量');\n      }\n\n      // 4. 调用Dify工作流\n      logger.info('调用技术通稿生成工作流', {\n        workflowId,\n        conversationCount: options.conversationIds.length,\n        outputCount: options.outputIds.length,\n        articleTypes: options.articleTypes,\n      });\n\n      const workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(workflowId, {\n        input: workflowInput,\n      });\n\n      if (!workflowResult.success || !workflowResult.data) {\n        throw new Error(\n          workflowResult.message || '工作流执行失败，未返回有效数据'\n        );\n      }\n\n      // 5. 解析工作流输出\n      const outputs = this.parseWorkflowOutput(workflowResult.data);\n\n      // 6. 构建返回结果\n      const result: MultiVersionArticle = {\n        sourceReferences: sourceData.references,\n        metadata: {\n          generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n          workflowId,\n          tokenUsage: this.extractTokenUsage(workflowResult.data),\n        },\n      };\n\n      // 根据请求的文章类型填充结果\n      if (options.articleTypes.includes('media_release') &amp;&amp; outputs.mediaRelease) {\n        result.mediaRelease = outputs.mediaRelease;\n      }\n      if (options.articleTypes.includes('internal_memo') &amp;&amp; outputs.internalMemo) {\n        result.internalMemo = outputs.internalMemo;\n  }\n}",

JSON.parse(file.tags) : [],\n      description: file.description,\n      usageCount: file.usage_count,\n      lastUsedAt: file.last_used_at,\n      createdAt: file.created_at,\n      updatedAt: file.updated_at,\n    }));\n\n    res.json(\n      formatApiResponse(true, fileList, '获取文件列表成功')\n    );\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(\n      formatApiResponse(\n        false,\n        null,\n        '获取文件列表失败',\n        error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n      )\n    );\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 删除文件（软删除）\n * DELETE /api/v1/ai-search/files/:fileId\n */",

        "contents": "// 配置multer用于文件上传\nconst storage = multer.diskStorage({\n  destination: (req, file, cb) =&gt; {\n    cb(null, 'uploads/ai-search/');\n  },\n  filename: (req, file, cb) =&gt; {\n    // 生成唯一文件名，但保留原始扩展名\n    const uniqueSuffix = Date.now() + '-' + Math.round(Math.random() * 1E9);\n    const ext = path.extname(file.originalname);\n    cb(null, &#96;${uniqueSuffix}${ext}&#96;);\n  },\n});\n\nconst upload = multer({\n  storage: storage,\n  limits: {\n    fileSize: 10 * 1024 * 1024, // 10MB\n  },\n  fileFilter: (req: Request, file: Express.Multer.File, cb: multer.FileFilterCallback) =&gt; {\n    // 允许的文件类型：PDF, PPT, txt, markdown, word\n    const allowedTypes = [\n      'application/pdf',\n      'application/vnd.ms-powerpoint', // .ppt\n      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation', // .pptx\n      'application/msword', // .doc\n      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document', // .docx\n      'text/plain',\n      'text/markdown',\n    ];\n    // 也允许通过扩展名判断\n    const allowedExtensions = ['.pdf', '.ppt', '.pptx', '.doc', '.docx', '.txt', '.md', '.markdown'];\n    const fileExtension = require('path').extname(file.originalname).toLowerCase();\n    \n    if (allowedTypes.includes(file.mimetype) || allowedExtensions.includes(fileExtension)) {\n      cb(null, true);\n    } else {\n      cb(new Error(&#96;不支持的文件类型: ${file.mimetype}。支持的类型：PDF, PPT, txt, markdown, word&#96;));\n    }\n  },\n});\n\n// 确保上传目录存在\nconst uploadDir = 'uploads/ai-search/';\nif (!fs.existsSync(uploadDir)) {\n  fs.mkdirSync(uploadDir, { recursive: true });\n}\n\n// 初始化服务\nconst aiSearchService = new AiSearchService();\nconst fieldMappingService = new FieldMappingService();\nconst createConversationUseCase = new CreateConversationUseCase(aiSearchService);\nconst getConversationsUseCase = new GetConversationsUseCase(aiSearchService);\nconst getConversationDetailUseCase = new GetConversationDetailUseCase(aiSearchService);\nconst sendMessageUseCase = new SendMessageUseCase;",

        "contents": "/**\n * 获取工作流配置\n * GET /api/v1/ai-search/workflow?pageType=tech-package|press-release\n */\nrouter.get('/workflow', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const pageType = req.query.pageType as string | undefined; // 'tech-package' | 'press-release'\n    const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows() as any[];\n    \n    // 根据页面类型选择不同的环境变量或默认工作流\n    let workflowIdFromEnv: string | null = null;\n    if (pageType === 'press-release') {\n      workflowIdFromEnv = process.env.PRESS_RELEASE_WORKFLOW_ID || process.env.AI_SEARCH_WORKFLOW_ID || null;\n    } else {\n      workflowIdFromEnv = process.env.AI_SEARCH_WORKFLOW_ID || null;\n    }\n\n    let resolvedWorkflowId: string | null = null;\n    const workflowsArray = workflows as any[];\n\n    if (workflowIdFromEnv) {\n      const matched = workflowsArray.find((workflow: any) =&gt; workflow.id === workflowIdFromEnv);\n      if (matched) {\n        resolvedWorkflowId = matched.id;\n      } else {\n        logger.warn('工作流ID指定的工作流不存在，已自动回退', {\n          workflowId: workflowIdFromEnv,\n          pageType,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (!resolvedWorkflowId) {\n      // 根据页面类型选择默认工作流名称\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflowsArray.find((workflow: any) =&gt; workflow.name === defaultWorkflowName);\n      resolvedWorkflowId = defaultWorkflow?.id || workflowsArray[0]?.id || null;\n    }\n\n    res.json(\n      formatApiResponse(\n        true,\n        { workflowId: resolvedWorkflowId },\n        '获取工作流配置成功'\n      )\n    );\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(\n      formatApiResponse(\n        false,\n        null,\n        '获取工作流配置失败',\n        error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n      )\n    );\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 文件上传\n * POST /api/v1/ai-search/upload\n */\nrouter.post",

        "contents": "/**\n * 手动触发子Agent\n * POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/agents\n */\nrouter.post('/conversations/:id/agents', ensureTablesInitialized, async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    const rawBody = req.body;\n    const dto = validateDTO(TriggerAgentSchema, rawBody);\n    // 确保 contextWindowSize 是 number 类型\n    const processedDto = {\n      ...dto,\n      contextWindowSize: typeof dto.contextWindowSize === 'number' ? dto.contextWindowSize : (dto.contextWindowSize ? parseInt(String(dto.contextWindowSize), 10) : undefined),\n    };\n    const result = await triggerAgentUseCase.execute(id, processedDto);\n\n    if (!result.success) {\n      if (result.error.code === 'CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND') {\n        return res.status(404).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '对话不存在', result.error.message));\n      }\n      if (result.error.code === 'WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND') {\n        return res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '未找到可用的工作流配置', result.error.message));\n      }\n      if (result.error.code === 'MAPPING_NOT_FOUND') {\n        return res.status(400).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '尚未配置字段映射，请先完成字段映射配置', result.error.message));\n      }\n      if (result.error.code === 'FEATURE_NOT_FOUND') {\n        return res.status(400).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, result.error.message));\n      }\n\n      return res.status(500).json(formatApiResponse(false, null, '子Agent执行失败', result.error.message));\n    }\n\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, result.value, '子Agent执行完成'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof ValidationException) {\n      const failure = formatValidationFailure(error);\n      return res.status(400).json(failure);\n    }\n\n    logger.error('子Agent执行失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(\n      formatApiResponse(\n        false,\n        null,\n        '子Agent执行失败',\n        error instanceof Error ?
